description: The log module contains commands and events relating to logging.

types.description: The severity of a log entry.

events.name: entryAdded
events.description: Fired when a new log entry is added.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The log entry type: console for console method calls and javascript for uncaught exceptions.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The realm, and its browsing context, that the log entry came from.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: The time the log entry was added, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

parameters.name: stackTrace
parameters.description: The JavaScript stack when the log entry was added.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: The console method that added a console log entry.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: The arguments of the console method that added a console log entry.
